name: RHEL
author: Arif Ahmed
description: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 (UBI) in the bar: one click opens a RHEL shell in your terminal, and the popup manages your RHEL containers — new shell, start, stop, remove, and one-click rebuild of the CLI-ready image (ncurses, vim, less on top of the stock UBI base).

barWidget.description: RHEL 10 UBI containers in the bar: click for a terminal into RHEL, manage running containers, rebuild the image.

schema.label: Image tag
schema.description: Local tag of the RHEL CLI image this widget builds and runs.

schema.label: Base image
schema.description: Upstream base the image is built FROM (public UBI needs no Red Hat login).
